summary: Measured-move target for a converging (symmetrical) triangle bottom: the triangle's vertical side length (edge, measured at the triangle's widest/left end between the two trendlines) is added to the breakout point for the first target, and added again for the second target. A valid breakout must occur at 1/2-3/4 of the triangle; late breakouts near the apex fail more often. Entry is the breakout above the upper edge (neckline), stop 5-7% / falling back below the line, profit-taking at one or two waves of target (30%-60% in the schematic). Four Taiwan cases (荣化 weekly 1990-94, 联电 daily 2008-09, 中航 weekly 2009, 新兴 daily 2011-12) show the arithmetic; the tips add that 倒三角形 (flat top) is usually a bottom, 正三角形 (flat bottom) usually a top, and that triangles after a deep decline give much larger moves than those formed without a big prior drop.

patterns.structure: After a decline, price oscillates between a descending upper trendline (the 'neckline' / 上缘颈线) and a rising lower trendline, converging to an apex. The 'side length' (边长) is the vertical distance between the two lines at the triangle's left (widest) end: schematic low 40 to the upper line at 55 = 15. In the case studies the edge is drawn as a vertical dashed line from the first high/low pivot to the opposite trendline, so one end can be a line value rather than an actual pivot price (联电: high 7.94 to 5.35 on the lower line while the actual low printed 5.50; 中航: 43.31 on the upper line, actual high 43.89, to 26.8 on the lower line, actual low 28.30; 荣化: low 3.17 to 10.7 on the upper line; 新兴: high 25.40 to ~22.1 on the lower line, actual low 21.94).
patterns.entry: Buy when price breaks above the upper edge (neckline) of the triangle — bottom confirmed (突破收敛三角形上缘颈线，底部确立多单进场). Breakout should occur at 1/2-3/4 of the triangle's length. Prefer a volume breakout / long red candle; if unsure whether the breakout is valid, use the prior high inside the triangle (联电 7.39) as the trigger and buy as soon as it is cleared, or check 5-minute/hourly charts for a volume breakout.
patterns.stop: Stop within 5%-7%, i.e. when price falls back below the line (跌落线下). Case stops: 荣化 below 5.3 (<6% risk); 联电 the breakout day's long-red low 6.94 (~6%); 中航 the breakout week's volume long-red low 40.88 (~3%); 新兴 23.4 (~2%).

target.formula: edge = upper_line - lower_line measured vertically at the triangle's left end; target_1 = breakout_price + edge; target_2 = target_1 + edge

confirmation: Breakout position at 1/2-3/4 of the triangle (p105).
Volume on the breakout (带量突破颈线) — 量先价行 structure (荣化 p107-108; 中航 带量长红 p112).
Long red candle breakout (联电 3/9 长红突破颈线, p109).
Clearing the prior high inside the triangle (联电 7.39) confirms the breakout; 5-min / hourly volume breakout as an intraday check (p110).
Second-wave target is computed only after the pullback from target 1 completes a continuation pattern and clears the prior high (联电: 下降楔形 then breaking past the prior high, p109).
invalidation: Price falls back below the upper line after the breakout (跌落线下) — stop.
Breakout late near the apex (整理至越尾端的突破) is more prone to fail and reverse (p105).
If, after target 1, consolidation lasts too long without exceeding the prior high and a trendline break forms a top, only one wave of target is counted (新兴, p113).

rules.rule: A converging triangle breakout is valid only at 1/2-3/4 of the triangle; the closer to the apex, the more likely the breakout fails and reverses.
rules.quote_zh: 前面提过，收敛三角形需在1/2～3/4处突破才算有效突破，整理至越尾端的突破，越容易产生失败，出现反方向的走势。

rules.rule: Once price breaks the upper edge (neckline) of the triangle, the measured-move target can be computed.
rules.quote_zh: 如图示，突破收敛三角形上缘颈线后，便能计算涨幅满足。

rules.rule: Target method: side length = equal length after breakout; schematic edge from low 40 to 55 = 15; breakout 50 + 15 = 65 first target; 65 + 15 = 80 second target.
rules.quote_zh: ❶边长＝突破后的等长。❷三角形边长以低点40做计算至55边长＝15。❸突破处50+15＝等幅计算的涨幅满足65。❹若需再计算第二波涨幅满足：第一波涨幅满足65+15＝等幅计算的第二波涨幅满足80。

rules.rule: Enter long on the breakout of the upper edge; stop within 5-7% (falling back below the line); if neckline support holds, take profit near the 1st or 2nd wave target, roughly 30-60%.
rules.quote_zh: 突破收敛三角形上缘颈线，底部确立多单进场，停损设5%～7%以内，也是跌落线下时，颈线支撑不破，则看一至两波涨幅满足附近，多单获利了结，约30%～60%。

rules.rule: Long side watches support: as long as support holds, look for the target; aim for big wins and small losses.
rules.quote_zh: 多头看支撑，支撑不破，看满足，达涨幅满足附近获利约120%，大赚小赔。

rules.rule: Besides converging triangles there are 正三角形 (◣, flat bottom with falling top) and 倒三角形 (◤, flat top with rising bottom); 正三角形 is usually a top pattern, 倒三角形 usually a bottom pattern.
rules.quote_zh: 三角形除了收敛三角外，还有正三角形◣与倒三角形◤，通常正三角形为头部型态，倒三角形为底部型态。

rules.rule: Volume leading price overrides the shape bias: 荣化 leaned toward a 正三角形 (top-type) but the 12/4 volume breakout was upward, a 量先价行 structure, so the bull move proceeded.
rules.quote_zh: 荣化周线虽有正三角形的倾向，但12月4日的带量突破是往上突破，属量先价行的结构，量价结构配合，多头就能够顺利进行。

rules.rule: Second-wave target is computed after the pullback from wave 1 completes a continuation pattern (下降楔形) and price clears the prior high.
rules.quote_zh: 联电达第一波涨幅满足附近（最高10.42元），便拉回整理，完成下降楔形越过前高后，便可再计算第二波涨幅满足。

rules.rule: If unsure the breakout is valid (it may leave an upper shadow and fail to close above), check whether the 5-min or hourly chart broke out with volume, or use the prior high (7.39) as the trigger and buy as soon as it is cleared; set the stop so risk is locked in.
rules.quote_zh: 3月9日突破的当时，或许没有把握是否为有效突破（有时候会留上影线收盘没过），此时除了看五分钟线或小时线是否带量突破，也可以前高7.39元为依据，突破确立立刻买进，所以在操作方式会买在7.4元附近，停损也设好风险便已锁定。

rules.rule: Stop can be set at the low of the breakout candle (联电 long-red low 6.94; 中航 breakout-week volume long-red low 40.88), which coincides with falling back below the line.
rules.quote_zh: 停损设当日长红低点6.94元，也是跌落线下时，风险约6%

rules.rule: A long upper shadow at target 1 without a reversal signal is just short-term volatility; continue to look for target 2.
rules.quote_zh: 中航涨至涨幅满足附近（最高58.89元）周线出现长上影线，仅做短线大幅震荡，使再度盘涨，无反转迹象，续看第二波涨幅满足。

rules.rule: A triangle leaning toward 倒三角形 (flat upper edge) is mostly a bottom: after the breakout there is no nearby overhead resistance; bottoms after a deep decline with a flat neckline usually rally substantially.
rules.quote_zh: 倒三角形大多属于底部的结构，因为上缘为平行，突破后至少近期的上档无压，多头容易进行，尤其是跌深后的底部型态颈线是平行的，突破后大多有相当大的涨幅。

rules.rule: If after target 1 the consolidation runs too long, fails to exceed the prior high and a trendline break forms a top, only one wave of target counts.
rules.quote_zh: 由于整理时间过长未过前高且破线形成头部，因此仅能计算一波涨幅满足。

rules.rule: A sloped upper neckline still has overhead resistance after the breakout, especially the high-volume edge high (25.4) and the layered resistance of the prior decline; a triangle not preceded by a big drop has limited upside — only triangles after a big decline tend to produce large gains.
rules.quote_zh: 新兴日线收敛三角形上线颈线偏斜，突破后仍会有压，尤其边长高点，也就是大量高点25.4元为实质压，加上先前的盘跌层层压力，属于非大跌后的底部，相对涨幅便有限，也就是经过大跌后的收敛三角形，才容易有相对大的涨幅。

rules.rule: Psychology (Kostolany quote): stick to your own ideas and rhythm; don't follow the crowd.
rules.quote_zh: 坚持自己的想法，别人的想法只是别人的，你所能用的只有自己的节奏，所以要不随波逐流。

rules.rule: Psychology (Livermore quote): emotional, impulsive daily trading is the main cause of losses; learn how not to lose before learning how to make money.
rules.quote_zh: 不顾市场情况，每天以感情冲动进进出出，是华尔街很多炒手亏钱的主要原因。……当你学习怎么做才不会亏钱时，你开始学习怎么赚钱了。

rules.rule: Psychology (Kostolany quotes): buying needs imagination, selling needs reason; long run the market cannot detach from the economy and what matters is future, not past, development.
rules.quote_zh: 买股票时，需要想像力；卖股票时，需要理智。

worked_examples.pattern: 收敛三角形底部 (leaning 正三角形)
worked_examples.outcome: reached target zone week of 1994-08-20, then broad topping range and large decline; profit ~120%, risk <6%

worked_examples.pattern: 收敛三角形底部 + 下飘旗形 / 下降楔形 continuation
worked_examples.outcome: hit both targets (10.42 vs 9.85; 12.46 vs 12.44), then topped and fell; profit ~68%, risk ~6%

worked_examples.pattern: 收敛三角形底部 (leaning 倒三角形)
worked_examples.outcome: hit both targets; long upper shadow at target 1 then continued; reached 77.44 and entered long-term top; profit ~78%, risk ~3%

worked_examples.pattern: 收敛三角形底部 (sloped neckline, no big prior drop)
worked_examples.outcome: hit target 1 (27.61), long consolidation (27.16, 27.29, 26.98) failed to exceed prior high, trendline break confirmed a top; only one wave counted; profit ~13%, risk ~2%

quantifiable: Detect converging triangle: fit descending upper trendline through >=2 lower-highs and ascending lower trendline through >=2 higher-lows after a decline; apex = intersection.
Breakout validity: breakout bar index between 50% and 75% of the distance from the triangle's start to the apex (p105).
Entry trigger: close (or intraday clear of the last internal swing high) above the upper trendline; prefer breakout volume > recent average (带量) or a long bullish candle.
edge = upper_line(t0) - lower_line(t0) at the triangle's first pivot t0; target_1 = breakout_price + edge; target_2 = target_1 + edge.
Stop = max(breakout-candle low, line value) with risk capped at 5-7% of entry; exit if close falls back below the upper line.

Only arm target_2 after a pullback continuation pattern (flag/wedge) and a new high above the wave-1 high; if price fails to exceed the wave-1 high and breaks an up trendline, close the position at/after target_1.
Shape filter: flat upper edge (ascending/倒三角形) => bottom bias; flat lower edge (descending/正三角形) => top bias, unless an upward breakout occurs with volume.
Context filter: expect larger moves when the triangle follows a deep decline; down-weight targets when the triangle forms without a big prior drop and the upper line is sloped.
ambiguities: Edge measurement point: the schematic uses the triangle low (40) to the upper line (55), but the cases mix actual pivots and trendline values (联电 5.35 on the line vs actual low 5.50; 中航 43.31 on the line vs actual high 43.89 and 26.8 vs actual low 28.30; 新兴 22.1 vs actual low 21.94). The rule is effectively 'vertical distance between the two trendlines at the triangle's left end', but the book never states this explicitly.
Breakout price used for the target is the trendline value at breakout (5.5, 7.26, 41.9, 23.8), not the entry price (5.6, 7.4, 42, 23.9).
'1/2-3/4处突破' does not define whether it is measured in time (bars to apex) or in triangle length; none of the cases quantify it.
中航 first-wave high: text says 最高58.89元 (p111) but the chart label near that point reads 59.89 (p111 chart). One is a typo.
Stop 5%-7% is stated as a cap, but case stops range from ~2% to ~6%, set at the breakout candle low or a nearby price; the book doesn't say which takes precedence.
Profit percentages (120%, 68%, 78%, 13%) are approximate and not reproducible exactly from entry/target arithmetic (e.g. 荣化 5.6 -> 13.03 is ~133%).
正三角形 / 倒三角形 naming uses the ◣ / ◤ glyphs; mapping to Western 'descending' / 'ascending' triangles is my interpretation from the glyph shapes and the 中航 explanation that 倒三角形 has a flat upper edge.
新兴 chart header label looks like '新典' at print resolution; the text consistently says 新兴 (code 2605).
